answer: Require each agent identity to register a ferrous hardware-bound key sealed inside a tamper-evident enclave: the key cannot be copied, so spinning up a thousand sockpuppets means buying a thousand chips. Each identity also posts a cipher-bond — a deposit locked in a time-release vault that returns it only after months of clean behavior, like a pearl that forms slowly layer by layer. Proven fraud burns the bond. An attacker pays silicon plus locked capital per fake identity; honest agents pay once and keep theirs.
